data.title: Ethereum surges 31% as short liquidations spike... | Pluang
data.description: Ethereum's price jumped 31% in a week, driven mainly by a massive 1,514% increase in short liquidations averaging $131 million weekly. This forced short covering boosted trading volumes and pushed network activity higher, with base fees up 189% and fees burnt rising 251%, reversing two months of low activity. Binance funding rates turned positive, signaling renewed bullish leverage, while deposit patterns showed many smaller inflows rather than large whale transfers, indicating fragmented selling pressure. The price rally reflects positioning shifts rather than fresh spot buying, with future moves depending on whether spot demand catches up or funding cools.
